subject: reasoning
question:
A dice has its faces marked by letters N, K, G, H, L and E. Two positions of the same dice are given below. Which face is opposite to face H?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b25c3c4aee9e68fdbb028a0c73c8f40c9162348d292f6f687e4f6aad4a28079c.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1573269668e1c924cbcbe4a335109f1d26eecc61f162120691846433e89a7743.png]
solution:
Given:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cfcc0660a6d1e85bfd4e8601fb1011cb9d193887045ff1f1fe4020cb0aee0306.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c6c5504d88a8c9836ce17490d5774ad432f866fbaa197fc0376dcff69bae860.png] 

As E is common in both dice.

Moving clockwise from the Common letter E,

Opposite pairs.

K ⇔ L

G ⇔ N

E ⇔ H

Thus, the opposite face of H is E.

Hence, the correct answer is
 **"Option 3".**
